description: This Java source file defines the IPCSender class, which provides methods for sending inter-process communication (IPC) requests over sockets, including direct local calls and remote TCP communication. It handles encoding/decoding payloads, connection management, and service availability checks.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends an IPC request to a specified server port with a message code and optional input/output payloads, managing socket connection, encoding, and decoding.

methods.name: isServiceAvailable
methods.description: Checks whether the specified IPC server port is available and responds to a ping request.

methods.name: waitForServiceAvailable
methods.description: Repeatedly checks if the service becomes available within a timeout period.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Attempts to establish a socket connection to a given InetAddress and port, retrying up to 5 times.

methods.name: encodePayload
methods.description: Encodes an ObjectIPC payload into a JSON string.

methods.name: decodePayload
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string payload into an ObjectIPC object.
